title: Fleet Air Compressor
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4877  355 CONS PK
description_text: This Request for Quotation is seeking vendors that are interested and capable of procuring the following below (or equal): 0001 - Gardner Denver Model L22 L-Series Oil-Flooded Rotary Air Compressor Fixed Speed, 30HP, 130 PSIG, 460Tri-Volt/3PH/60Hz, 120 Gallon Tank Mounted Rotary, Three Valve Bypass Refrigerated Dryer, Coalescing Filter, 115 Volt, Electric Tank Drain (or equivalent) 0002 - Oil Water Separator Model GDP-350 (or equivalent) For additional information, please refer to the attached documents below: 1. Salient Characteristics 2. Provisions and Clauses - Air Compressor 3. COMBO - RFQ FA487726QA093 Important Dates a. All questions must be submitted via email no later than 6 May 2026, 02:00 PM MDT - Answers will be posted in this RFQ no later than COB 8 May 2026, 11:59 PM MDT b. All quotes must be submitted via email no later than 12 May 2026, 02:00 PM MDT
